records.title: KAI FORM 10Q Q1 2023
records.text: Consolidated revenue increased 1% in the first quarter of 2023, including a 4% decrease from the unfavorable effect of foreign currency translation.

records.title: KAI FORM 10Q Q1 2023
records.text: We had record bookings of $274.5 million in the first quarter of 2023, surpassing the previous record set in the first quarter of 2022 despite inflationary pressures and a $9.2 million unfavorable effect of foreign currency translation.

records.title: KAI FORM 10Q Q1 2023
records.text: Our backlog increased 14% sequentially to $393.0 million at the end of the first quarter of 2023, providing a robust start to 2023.

records.title: KAI FORM 10Q Q1 2023
records.text: Although supply chain constraints have resulted in inflationary pressure on material costs, longer lead times, and increased freight costs, these constraints have recently eased.

records.title: KAI FORM 10Q Q1 2023
records.text: This use of cash was offset in part by $11.1 million of cash provided by customer deposits.
